Fam Trip rates: JNH - USD75 Single, Double - USD 95 BB, JIOBR - High USD 100 and 150 Double half board, JIOBR mid
Season - USD 90 Single and USD 120 double and Low Season - USD 75 single, USD 110 HB
LEL (Half Board) - USD 70 Single and USD 100 Double
Transfers
Transfers from JKIA - JNH - USD 35 one way, USD 70 return per vehicle. Groups of 5 and above - USD 18 per person
Transfers from Ukunda to IOBR - USD 25 per trip per vehicle of 5 pax and USD 65 for 14 pax.
Transfers from Moi - JIOBR - USD 85 per trip per vehicle of 5 pax, US 120 for 10 pax and USD 170 per trip for 20 pax.
Transfers from Miritini- JIOBR-USD 85 per trip per vehicle of 5 pax, US 120 for 10 pax and USD 170 per trip for 20 pax.
Special Offers
* Day room rates/Late check out = Apply from noon to 1400hrs at 75% and upto 1800hrs at 100% of the overnight rate.
Past 1800hrs accrues full overnight rate
* Rooms allocation - 2 daily with a release period of 24 hours.
* Conference supplement of USD 38 per person full day and USD 35 half day at JH and IOBR. LEL at USD 30 and USD 25
* Group meal rates of 5 pax plus at all our Restaurants at USD 30 per person and get 1 meal free for the driver/Tour Leader
* Snacks menu and Fruit platters at USD 18 per person. Snacks Menu comprises of Either sandwiches, sausages,
chicken wings, samosas, omelette, French fries and tea/coffee
* Circuit Discount made at a time in all our three (3) Hotels at 5%
* Tour Leader Free after every group of 15 and above
* All inclusive drinks supplement (Kenyan local premium drinks only) at USD.50 per person sharing per day
* Half Board plus/Full Board plus supplement at USD 12 per person per meal (2 local beers + water, 1 glass of wine/cocktail
+ water per person or 2 glasses of soft drinks + water) for Kenyan Local premium drinks and soft drinks
Activities
* Access to the Gym, sauna, heated pool steam and our Phenomenal Spa at Jacaranda Nairobi
* Guided Nature Trail at Lake Elementaita Lodge at USD 10 per adult and USD 5 per child, indoor and outdoor games
* Inhouse animation team available for groups, children and daily entertainment at Indian Ocean Beach Resort
* Spacious grounds and rooms for evening parties, graduations, birthdays, baby showers, wedding bridal showers and
Group lunches
* Kid's activities available at Jacaranda Indian Ocean Beach Resort and Jacaranda Lake Elementaita Lodge
Payment and Cancellation Policy
* Booking Voucher to be presented in advance and 100% Deposit made fourteen (14 days) before checking in.
* In case the Operator enjoys credit facilities with the hotel, payments in full should be made at the appropriate rates
within thirty days of the presentation of an invoice
* All booking cancellations must be advised in writing to the reservations team on email at cro@jacarandahotels.com
* Charges for cancellation and reduction in the number more than 48 hours before noon on the date of accommodation
are only applicable to Groups (defined as ten or more paying persons) and individuals
* Group cancellation between 7 and 2 days from noon on the date of accommodation -35% of the rate applicable.
* Cancellation and No-show fees within 48 hours from noon on the date of accommodation 100% of the net value of
the booking.
* All rates are in the nominated foreign currency and will be billed in that currency
* No refund will be issued for any cancellation made within 7 days before check in date
Contract signed by: For: TOUR / TRAVEL AGENT
LUCY NDARWA, ASSISTANT GROUP SALES & MARKETING MANAGER Title: _______________________
DORIS MAKENA, GROUP SALES & MARKETING MANAGER
C.C. ERICK KARANI, CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER Date: _______________________
